Confusing reviews on this product so I figured I would do the world some justice and let you know how this product really is. For starters, its definitely the best product I have ever tried. Never did I ever imagine I would buy a $100 skin care product once, let alone twice. I hate the price tag but I will keep buying it. It is a retinol, so yes, you will likely dry out at first. It should not be used nightly, you have to work up to that. I started with twice a week for two weeks, then every other day for 3 weeks, and then daily. You will probably still get flakey for little bit, you will probably have the typical acne purge that happens with any retinol. It is very worth it to get passed that drying and acne phase. If youre slow and steady enough, you might be able to avoid it. I dont know why people in the reviews are claiming this is a hydrating product. Maybe it feels hydrating the moment you put it on, but its a retinol. It is very important that you use moisturizer with this. If your skin is extra sensitive, I would apply the moisturizer before the serum. Once you build a tolerance and you want to absorb more product, then under the moisturizer. This is the only product that truly can make your sebaceous filaments disapear if used correctly, not even joking. It is pretty crazy how tiny, nearly invisible, your pores will get if you use this product consistently for a few months. I receive so many compliments on my skin. It definitely made my skin look better than anythin
